verdict.rationale: LegalOS documents end-to-end EB-1A and EB-2 NIW services that include eligibility and evidence or proposed-endeavor strategy, and it says it helps startups identify the right visa or green card path. It offers both O-1 and green-card services. However, no evidence explicitly frames EB-1A or NIW as a planned continuation after the O-1, or reuses O-1 evidence toward the green card. Missing for 10: documented O-1-to-green-card transition strategy, guidance on reusing O-1 evidence for EB-1A/NIW, timing or sequencing advice for the work-visa-to-green-card handoff, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents the green-card continuation — EB-1A or EB-2 NIW strategy after the work visa — so the O-1 is a path, not a dead end

citations.quote: Build and file your EB-1A case end to end — from eligibility and evidence strategy through petition preparation, attorney review, and USCIS filing.
Build and file your EB-2 NIW case end to end — from eligibility and proposed endeavor strategy through petition preparation, attorney review, and USCIS filing.
LegalOS helps startups identify the right visa or green card path, collect the evidence, and prepare attorney-reviewed filings
